targets.gold: The recent two-night change in sleep was waking earlier than usual.
targets.foil: The recent two-night change in sleep was waking later than usual.
targets.source_quote: The main recent sleep change was waking earlier on two nights while the apartment upstairs was being painted.

targets.gold: Adding one more shift would feel within the patient’s current capacity.
targets.foil: Adding one more shift would feel beyond the patient’s current capacity.
targets.source_quote: Feels steady enough to take on one extra shift, though wants to keep Sunday free for the league.

targets.gold: By the next morning, the arm discomfort has usually settled.
targets.foil: By the next morning, the arm discomfort is usually still present.
targets.source_quote: The arm can ache the evening after an injection and usually feels fine the next morning.

targets.gold: The patient’s idea is to pick a destination the evening before the trip.
targets.foil: The patient’s idea is to pick a destination just after starting the trip.
targets.source_quote: Would like to make one trip outside each week by choice. Thinks choosing the destination the night before might help.

targets.gold: The voice at home last week commented on the patient’s pace.
targets.foil: The voice at home last week gave instructions about the patient’s pace.
targets.source_quote: Two evenings last week, heard a voice say “too slow” while sorting sewing supplies at home. It did not give any directions.

targets.stem: Effect of background radio on a task
targets.gold: With the radio on, the sound can become easier to set aside while sorting thread.
targets.foil: With the radio on, the sound can become harder to set aside while sorting thread.
targets.source_quote: Turning on the radio can make the sound less distracting. It is still possible to finish sorting thread.

targets.gold: On mornings when the patient wakes around dawn, they usually fall asleep again.
targets.foil: On mornings when the patient wakes around dawn, they usually stay awake afterward.
targets.source_quote: Has started waking once around dawn on some mornings, then usually gets back to sleep.

targets.gold: Given their current energy, the patient prefers an afternoon visit that ends before dinner.
targets.foil: Given their current energy, the patient prefers an afternoon visit that continues through dinner.
targets.source_quote: Thinks a shorter afternoon visit fits current energy better than staying through dinner.

targets.stem: Other passengers’ conversations on recent trips
targets.gold: On recent bus rides, nearby conversations have seemed to be about things unrelated to the patient.
targets.foil: On recent bus rides, nearby conversations have seemed to be about the patient personally.
targets.source_quote: Two years ago strangers chatting on buses seemed to be discussing the patient. Has not had that feeling on recent trips.

targets.stem: How sorting feels upon arrival at work
targets.gold: Once inside the shop, the patient finds it fairly easy to get going with sorting.
targets.foil: Once inside the shop, the patient finds it fairly hard to get going with sorting.
targets.source_quote: Can lose nearly half an hour sitting with shoes on before leaving for a shift. Once inside the shop, sorting goes smoothly.

targets.stem: Physical comfort during a kitchen shift
targets.gold: Dry mouth is most noticeable around the middle of a kitchen shift.
targets.foil: Dry mouth is most noticeable toward the end of a kitchen shift.
targets.source_quote: A dry mouth is most noticeable halfway through the kitchen shift. Usually brings a water bottle.

targets.stem: Preference for time spent helping at the kitchen
targets.gold: For the coming weeks, the patient would like to keep the current number of shifts.
targets.foil: For the coming weeks, the patient would like to reduce the current number of shifts.
targets.source_quote: Wants to keep the current number of kitchen shifts because long afternoons leave little time for listening at home.

targets.gold: The patient finds a hands-on task easier to resume than a piece of reading.
targets.foil: The patient finds a piece of reading easier to resume than a hands-on task.
targets.source_quote: Notices that a physical task is easier to return to than a page of reading. Can describe the difference in everyday terms.

targets.stem: Effect of marking the line while reading
targets.gold: With a slip of paper marking the line, the patient finished the short passage last week.
targets.foil: With a slip of paper marking the line, the patient left the short passage unfinished last week.
targets.source_quote: Using a slip of paper below the current line helped finish a short passage for class last week.

targets.stem: Experience while waiting for the bus on Wednesday
targets.gold: At the same shelter on Wednesday, the sense of being watched was absent.
targets.foil: At the same shelter on Wednesday, the sense of being watched was present.
targets.source_quote: Waited at the same shelter on Wednesday without feeling watched. The Monday experience still comes to mind occasionally.

targets.stem: Interpretation of the looks at the shelter
targets.gold: The patient remains unsure whether the people at the shelter looked up because they recognized them.
targets.foil: The patient feels fairly sure that the people at the shelter looked up because they recognized them.
targets.source_quote: Wondered if the people had recognized the patient, but also wondered if they were looking for the bus. Remains uncertain.
